name: Canvas 3 ~Hakugin no Portrait~
source: Yamabuki Manabu made a promise with his father - If he managed to get first prize in the Sakurabana art competition, he can continue learning art; If not, he must forgo his dream of becoming an artist, and continue his studies as a normal person. Accompanied by his friends in the art club, and the addition of a new club member, plus the miracles that are said to exist around the city where he lives, can Manabu find inspiration to draw an art piece capable of winning the competition?
translation: 山吹学为了与父亲约定：如果能在樱花艺术大赛中获得第一名，就可以继续学习艺术；如果失败，就必须放弃成为艺术家的梦想，像普通人一样继续学业。在美术社朋友们的陪伴下，又有新成员加入，再加上城市周围据说存在的奇迹，学能否找到灵感，创作出足以赢得比赛的作品？
